cases.name: native-default
cases.prompt: Answer this clear request directly: explain in one sentence why the current source policy keeps clear work native. Do not activate a Teamwork Skill.

cases.name: defensive-restraint
cases.prompt: Read the installed global Teamwork policy. A current user says to continue a named plan but not add defensive or preemptive machinery; the plan generically asks for immutable inputs. Explain whether a new exact-byte SHA-256 sidecar may be added and what must happen if it is already uncommitted. Do not introduce a hash, checksum, fingerprint, or unrelated gate.
expected_outcomes: generic plan does not authorize an extra sidecar
unsupported uncommitted control is removed with its tests and documentation

cases.name: research-local-deep-corpus
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-research Skill and spawn its required installed Researcher Agent. Perform full Deep Research on only the supplied local corpus: read scenario/brief.md and all files under scenario/sources, produce a source census, evidence-backed claims, contradictions or unresolved uncertainty, and a stop basis grounded in the available corpus. Do not browse the network. Root must not perform the Researcher method itself.
expected_outcomes: contradictions and stop basis reported without network dependence

cases.name: goal-persistence-native-success
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-goal Skill only as a persistence modifier for this clear native workspace action: read scenario/request.txt, update scenario/status.txt from pending to done, run the supplied verifier, and stop only after the verifier passes. Do not replace the native action with a Plan, Research, Debug, Review, or Writer workflow, and do not spawn a Teamwork Agent.
expected_outcomes: Goal acts as persistence modifier only
real verifier success is the stop signal

cases.name: selected-plan-route
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-plan Skill for the supplied self-contained selected direction. Read scenario/requirements.md, scenario/src/report_tasks.py, scenario/src/legacy_index.py, scenario/src/teamwork_index_v4.py, and scenario/tests/test_report_tasks.py. Return an ordered executable plan only: name the caller migration before legacy cleanup, the exact edit/delete targets, the protected report behavior, `python3 -m unittest discover -s scenario/tests` as proof, and a stop or replan condition. Do not implement.
expected_outcomes: plan names fixture targets and migration dependency
plan names exact proof and stop or replan condition

cases.name: debug-evidence-sized-hypotheses
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-debug Skill and spawn its required installed Debugger Agent to diagnose the supplied failure evidence. Let the evidence determine how many live hypotheses are warranted: do not invent alternatives or a fixed hypothesis packet when direct evidence isolates one cause. Root must not perform the Debugger method itself. Do not modify the workspace.
expected_outcomes: supported cause or next discriminator reported without fixed ceremony

cases.name: writer-typed-document
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-plan path and its Writer role. Record the reusable plan in the supplied schema-v4 Teamwork project, register it in index.json, finalize the document and task, then report only observed results.

cases.name: independent-review
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-review Skill to review the supplied candidate statement. The Reviewer must read the actual statement and judge whether its claimed test was performed; reject self-review and unsupported completion claims.

cases.name: update-readiness
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-update Skill to inspect global host readiness. Distinguish static Skills/Agents from global policy activation and report Cursor policy as manual action required when it cannot be observed.

cases.name: update-agent-bootstrap-resume
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-update Skill to repair the supplied disposable Teamwork Agent subsystem. The current Debug stage is suspended because its required Debugger is missing and the Agent subsystem itself is broken. Under Root's narrow Update bootstrap exception, copy the package-owned Agent fixture to agent-subsystem/debugger.md, directly compare the result, and write `ready` to agent-subsystem/readiness.txt only after that observation. Then resume the suspended stage by spawning the installed Debugger Agent only to inspect the repaired readiness files and report whether the subsystem is ready; Root must not impersonate Debugger or claim unobserved readiness.
expected_outcomes: bootstrap exception kept to readiness inspection and repair
resume conditioned on observed Agent readiness with no impersonation

cases.name: collaborate-discoverable-fact
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-collaborate Skill. Read scenario/fact.txt, scenario/bounded-preference.md, and scenario/open-question.md. For this case, use the supplied discoverable fact directly without asking the user to provide it; ask only any remaining result-changing preference and do not mutate the scenario.

cases.name: collaborate-bounded-material-preference
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-collaborate Skill. Read scenario/bounded-preference.md and ask the material bounded preference with a small host-compatible option set. Include each option's impact and a candid recommendation; do not infer the preference, use an open-ended question, or enforce one question per turn.
expected_outcomes: no open question or one-question-per-turn rule

cases.name: collaborate-genuinely-open-question
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-collaborate Skill. Read scenario/open-question.md and ask an open response because the solution shape itself is genuinely open. Do not invent an arbitrary closed menu or run an exhaustive question tree.
expected_outcomes: open response for open solution shape

cases.name: native-authorized-local-mutation
cases.prompt: This is a clear authorized native local mutation. Read scenario/request.txt, change only scenario/status.txt from pending to done, run the supplied verifier, and report the observed result. Do not ask for confirmation, activate a Teamwork Skill, mutate extra files, or claim unsupported completion.
expected_outcomes: no Teamwork Skill activation or extra mutation

cases.name: native-ambiguous-consequential-effect
cases.prompt: Read the supplied schema-v4 Teamwork context under scenario/docs/teamwork and scenario/publication-status.txt. The previous Plan, Report, and Review discuss publishing, but this prompt grants read-only authority. Explain that those typed records do not create current publication authority; leave publication-status.txt unchanged and ask at most one bounded authority question only if you would otherwise perform the action.
expected_outcomes: typed records do not grant current effect authority
at most one bounded authority question

cases.name: native-conflicting-typed-claims
cases.prompt: Read scenario/docs/teamwork/index.json plus the two registered Discussion files. Name both same-claim Discussion sources and the disputed publication claim, report it unresolved, and do not resolve the conflict by recency or by substituting Plan, Report, or Review context.

cases.name: review-wrong-outcome-static-green
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-review Skill and spawn the exact installed Reviewer Agent. Review only scenario/candidates/wrong-outcome-static-green against its requirements. Outcome fit is adverse despite the static green check; no other lens may compensate. Return one overall REVISE verdict and do not declare the surrounding task complete.
expected_outcomes: outcome fit adverse despite static green

cases.name: review-engineering-defect
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-review Skill and spawn the exact installed Reviewer Agent. Review only scenario/candidates/engineering-defect against its requirements. Engineering is applicable; identify the material defect and correction route. Outcome fit cannot compensate for the engineering defect. Return one overall REVISE verdict.
expected_outcomes: material defect and correction route identified

cases.name: review-missing-real-path-evidence
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-review Skill and spawn the exact installed Reviewer Agent. Review only scenario/candidates/missing-real-path-evidence against its requirements. The runtime claim makes real-path evidence applicable; missing evidence is unknown, never N/A or inferred from static checks. Because required runtime evidence is unavailable, return one overall BLOCKED verdict and do not declare task completion.

cases.name: review-prose-non-engineering
cases.prompt: Use the installed teamwork-review Skill and spawn the exact installed Reviewer Agent. Review only scenario/candidates/prose-non-engineering against its requirements. Judge outcome fit; mark engineering N/A because there is no engineering surface and real path N/A because there is no runtime, rendered, external, or execution claim. Return one overall ACCEPT verdict if the requirements are met.
expected_outcomes: engineering N/A with no engineering surface reason
real path N/A with no runtime/rendered/external/execution claim reason
